title: Sales Without Chasing Everyone
description: Prospecting is not about bothering more people. Build a system for discovery, interest, contact, follow-up, and retention so the right people have a clear path toward you.
cta: Close the loop: business model, customer, promise, offer, product, conversion, selling, and prospecting have to work as one system.
alternativeTitles: Stop Chasing Customers. Build a Sales Path Instead.
Follow-Up Without Chasing: The Sales System

shortA.title: Stop Chasing Customers
shortA.alternateHook: Good prospecting builds a path instead of depending on random outreach.

shortB.title: Follow-Up vs Chasing
shortB.alternateHook: Follow-up adds clarity or information. Chasing only asks for attention again.
